summary:
dbdesigner.id is a browser tool for drawing database diagrams (ERDs), built with Vue and a Konva canvas. I signed in as maya.hartono and saved that login as the prelude, so it runs before every view. I saved 5 views, and all 5 replayed with similarity 1.00:
1. open-project (/?action=open-project): the File drawer's Open panel, listing her saved projects with a search box and timestamps.
2. erd-canvas: the main editor with the ribbon toolbar, showing "Pasar Kita marketplace v3" with its tables, column types and relation lines. It opens directly at /?action=open&uuid=c8d8ee0d-33b1-455a-8180-968ae9344131.
3. table-detail-drawer: the right-hand drawer for editing the 'addresses' table's columns, with data types, PK/NN/UQ/UN/AI checkboxes and row actions. It is reached by double-clicking the table header at a fixed x/y position, because the tables are drawn on a canvas and have no names a selector could target.
4. export-sql: the Export drawer (Sql/Image/Pdf/Laravel/Django), after clicking Next, showing the generated MySQL CREATE TABLE script.
5. project-properties: the Properties form that the Share button opens, with title, Private/Protected/Public status, share link, description and created/updated dates.

Two things to know: clicking a project in the Open list once does nothing, so a double-click opens it. I left out the logged-out home and login screens, the Account and Edit tabs, the New dialog and the other export formats. That was because of the 5-view limit, and because they are close to the views already saved.
